symptoms: Angular, white to greyish spots on the lower leaf surface with violet edges
White powdery fungal growth visible on the underside of spots
Spots join, leaves turn yellow-brown and drop prematurely
Usually appears after boll set in humid weather

severity_cues.early: Few angular white spots on lower leaves
severity_cues.advanced: White sporulation across the canopy, premature defoliation

favorable_conditions: High humidity, warm overcast weather, dense late-season canopy

treatment.summary: Systemic fungicide on schedule and defoliation management
steps: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC at 1.0 ml per litre, repeat after 12 to 15 days if humid
Spray coverage matters: wet both leaf surfaces
Do not delay pickings, open bolls suffer from falling debris

products.name: Propiconazole 25 EC
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period on cotton 14 days

organic: Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 2.5 to 3.0 g per litre as a protectant

source.org: ICAR Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), cotton disease advisory
source.title: Cotton: gray mildew management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not pick cotton within 14 days of spray
